name: sim_all_caretaken_waits_out_windows
description: Every seat of a hollow caretaken (both players away, or a balance run where the bots are the caretaker): the early horn is the players' call, so the hollow waits out each build window and its caretakers build in it, as they would beside a player. Before, the horn sounded on each window's first tick, before the caretakers could think, so every build fell in a wave and full early gold went to nobody present (review M1 determinism 2).

steps.msg: no horn before the first window runs out
both caretakers built in the first window
the first wave came when the countdown ran out
and no early gold was paid
the caretakers play the match to its end
